# crates.io crates an Argos module may depend on: `name exact-version [build-script]`.
# Any other crate, or any other version in Cargo.lock, is refused by `argos-modules build`.
# `build-script` marks a crate whose build script (code that runs on the build machine,
# outside the sandbox) was reviewed; a crate with an unmarked build script is refused.
# Procedural macros are always refused.
# Adding or upgrading a crate is an Argos decision after review (licence, unsafe code,
# build script). The Argos module kit (argos-module-sdk) is the only path dependency.

# Serialization, without the derive macros.
serde 1.0.229 build-script
serde_core 1.0.229 build-script

# Exact decimal amounts (money): never f64.
rust_decimal 1.43.0 build-script
arrayvec 0.7.8
num-traits 0.2.19 build-script
# Library used by the num-traits build script to detect compiler features.
autocfg 1.5.1
